description: Ministry of Defence - Amend the Name List of Uttama Seva Paddakkama (Air Force)
categorisation: This gazette notification specifically lists named individuals (Wing Commanders W W N T P Fernando, S S Dissanayake, K G Dissanayake, and R K P Udaya Kumara) and their service numbers in relation to amendments to the Uttama Seva Padakkama (a military honor) name list. It involves personnel changes (deletions and insertions from the honor list) but does not describe any detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes. The content focuses exclusively on specific individuals and their military honors, fitting the definition of a People Gazette.
